import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read source data
sales = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
sales['month'] = pd.to_datetime(sales['month'])

# Aggregate revenue by region and month, then index each region to January = 100
monthly = sales.groupby(['region', 'month'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
monthly = monthly.sort_values('month')
monthly['indexed_revenue'] = monthly.groupby('region')['revenue'].transform(lambda s: s / s.iloc[0] * 100)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for region, group in monthly.groupby('region'):
    ax.plot(group['month'], group['indexed_revenue'], marker='o', label=region)

ax.set_title('Revenue by Region (January = 100)')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue index (January = 100)')
ax.set_ylim(0, monthly['indexed_revenue'].max() * 1.08)
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
